Definition: from G575 and a derivative of G3737; to bereave wholly, i.e. (figuratively) separate (from intercourse):--take.
BiblicalUsage: Paul uses this word once, for being torn away from the Thessalonians for a short time, in presence but not in heart. It is the language of bereavement, not of a planned goodbye.
TheologicalSignificance: Being kept apart from people you love still hurts, even when the parting is short.
